# ThousandEyes Provider

Manages ThousandEyes resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    thousandeyes = {
      source = "deploymenttheory/thousandeyes"
    }
  }
}

provider "thousandeyes" {
  # Credentials are read from the environment when not set here.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_group_id` (String) Scopes every request to an account group, sent as the `aid` query parameter. When unset, the API uses the token owner's default account group, which means an object can appear absent rather than merely invisible. May also be set with the `THOUSANDEYES_ACCOUNT_GROUP_ID` environment variable.
- `api_endpoint` (String) Overrides the API base URL. Defaults to the endpoint the SDK was generated against. May also be set with the `THOUSANDEYES_API_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) A bearer token for the ThousandEyes API, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. May also be set with the `THOUSANDEYES_BEARER_TOKEN` environment variable.

How the token is issued and revoked is the API's own business: see the ThousandEyes documentation. The provider never logs it.
